notes: The appositional 'even' (t022) is correctly `added`: the verse writes no object marker at all and no connective before 'all the men of war', which is precisely rule 16's stated limit on the *even*/*to wit* family.
In 'all the men of war' the rectum is rendered anarthrously, so rule 29 fronts the written 'the' to the rectum's article s019 and leaves the construct s018 bare.
Both `הַ` + participle/adjective attributives (s011, s015) take the ASV's relative under rule 41, with the copula staying on the predicate word.
